title: BRoverbs - Measuring how much LLMs understand Portuguese proverbs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model comprehension of regional cultural knowledge by testing the ability of LLMs to correctly match region-specific Brazilian proverbs to short narrative stories (and vice versa) in a multiple-choice format.

Assessing the disparity in LLM performance on native Brazilian Portuguese idiomatic and figurative expressions, highlighting systemic biases caused by the underrepresentation of non-English languages in pretraining data.
